description: This file contains JavaScript functions that interface with a backend API to fetch user-related data, such as user projects and basic user information. It exports two asynchronous functions: getUserProjects and getUserBasic.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a user's projects from session tracking using a backend endpoint, with optional query parameters like organization, date range, and userId filtering.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId)
methods.description: Retrieves minimal user information by MongoDB ObjectId, handling 404 errors gracefully by returning null for the name.
